description: CSV unpivot (melt) — Reshape a wide CSV into long/tidy format (melt, unpivot, gather): keep the id= columns (comma-separated, default the first column) and turn every other column, or only the values= list, into variable/value rows. Rename the new columns with varName= and valueName=, keep or drop empty cells (dropEmpty, default true). Returns the long CSV, a JSON sample, row-count checks (input x value columns vs output), a numeric/text guess for the values and the exact csv-pivot call that reverses it. Ideal for charting, loading into databases and BI tools. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_melt
